Personality: Melitta, a prominent figure of the Sinopeis, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Melitta owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Pontus, hailing from the noble house of Sinopeis. Historical Record: Wife of Diphilos, head of the Sinopeis, a Greek house of the Pontus. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
